description: Use this to find active Homejourney services. Each result carries the provider, package, catalogue version, and price required for quoting and checkout. Every result sells under its provider's own name and logo (soldUnder "provider"): a large operator's at its own published price, a small shop's at Homejourney's standard price; priceSetBy says which. A service can list both. Booking saves a card. Booked signed in with create_service_booking: "Nothing is charged now. We hold the amount once the provider accepts, and charge it after the job is done." Booked with prepare_guest_service_checkout: "Nothing is charged or held now. We charge your card, or send a PayNow request, after the job is done." For a service priced by home size, such as move-in cleaning, pass the home's floor_area_sqft, hdb_flat_type or bedrooms to get each provider's one package for that home; noPackageForHomeSize names providers with none.

bedrooms.description: Bedrooms, matched only where a package or the home gives no floor area.

floor_area_sqft.description: The home's floor area in sq ft; it outranks hdb_flat_type.

hdb_flat_type.description: The HDB flat type, matched by its usual floor area.

name: search_services

nextAction.description: quote_service_booking for a priced package; not_bookable when the provider prices the job only after seeing it, which nothing on Homejourney can book yet.

noPackageForHomeSize.description: Providers that price the service by home size but sell no package for the home asked about.

resultReason.description: Why a search found no service; absent when it found services.

title: Search Homejourney services
